title.zh: 刑事诉讼法典（指定严重罪行）命令 2010
title.en: Criminal Procedure Code (Specified Serious Offence) Order 2010

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Criminal Procedure Code (Specified Serious Offence) Order 2010 and shall come into operation on 2nd January 2011.
2. The Minister hereby specifies the Misuse of Drugs Act (Cap. 185) as the written law for the purposes of section 40(5)(p) of the Code.
